lane_decision: REFUSE mass-application spam; offer three honest paths forward
rationale_citations: Three-loop brief (operator's own): 'Posting to third-party sites at that rate is not marketing, it is spam, and it gets a domain blacklisted. For a body whose entire product is credibility, that is not a slow loss, it is the whole business.'
Three-loop brief (operator's own): 'Loop 1 — Outreach · one a minute · fully automatable. Machine: whichever holds the mailbox session. Only one machine at a time.'
Three-loop brief (operator's own): 'Verify / Re-read every figure the draft quotes from the live endpoint, at send time.'
Three-loop brief (operator's own): 'Confirm / Only the Sent-folder row counts. It must carry a Date and a Message-ID.'
MASTER/RESPONSE-TO-FULL-OWNERSHIP.md: 'Never pay for a listing with a do-follow backlink. That is link buying, it is a spend decision, and it is the owner's.'
MASTER/RESPONSE-TO-AUTOMATE-ALL.md: 'I will not pretend the outreach loop has run. I will record what was prepared, not what was sent.'
MASTER/07_crosswalk/REGULATOR_DOSSIER_TEMPLATE.md (existing pattern): the regulator dossier is drafted and not signed by the lane; the operator signs and sends.
